newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht falls, interbank rate steady late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht falls, interbank rate steady late.

text.p: The Thai baht dropped sharply against the dollar in late trade on Monday on short covering of the U.S. unit, dealers said.
The baht weakened to 25.910/25.920 to the dollar late from 25.873/25.877 early, dealers said. The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate at 25.85 per dollar against 26.05 on Friday.
"There was heavy buying of the dollar the whole day today. Some players who heavily sold the dollar last week were buying back the dollar to cover their positions," said one dealer at a local bank.
